# RealDays
> Unique experiences run by the local people who started them. In Victoria, Australia.

RealDays is a booking site for small, owner-run experience businesses. We started in Victoria and now welcome businesses from anywhere in Australia. Nothing to join and nothing a month.

## Pages
- [Home](https://getrealdays.com/)
- [Victoria, Australia](https://getrealdays.com/mornington-peninsula/)
- [FAQ](https://getrealdays.com/#faq)
- [For businesses](https://getrealdays.com/for-business/)

## Experiences in Victoria, Australia
- [All experiences as JSON](https://getrealdays.com/experiences.json): one record per experience. Null means not confirmed.
- [Workshops and classes in Victoria](https://getrealdays.com/workshops/)
- [Workshops and classes in Melbourne](https://getrealdays.com/melbourne/)
- [Workshops in regional Victoria](https://getrealdays.com/regional-victoria/)

### Adventure Flight Co, Barwon Heads
High-G aerobatic flights in an ex-military warbird from Barwon Heads and Moorabbin airports, just you and the pilot.
- [Warbird aerobatic flight](https://getrealdays.com/adventure-flight-co/): $365 to $695 AUD per person, 15, 25 or 35 minutes in the air. Loop, roll and spin in an ex-military Nanchang CJ-6A warbird, with just you and the pilot.

### Aysha Hansen, Newtown, Geelong
Perfume workshops in Newtown, Geelong, run by perfumer Aysha Hansen.
- [Make your own perfume in a Geelong atelier](https://getrealdays.com/aysha-hansen/): $199 to $249 AUD per person, 2 hours. Blend your own fragrance from 70 ingredients with perfumer Aysha Hansen.

### Elizabeth Peddey School of Cookery, Elwood
Mediterranean home cooking classes in Elizabeth Peddey's kitchen in Elwood, Melbourne.
- [Mediterranean Summer Cooking, Wednesdays](https://getrealdays.com/elizabeth-peddey/): $185 to $720 AUD per person, 3-hour classes, one a week for 4 weeks, or a single class. Four weekly Mediterranean cooking classes in a small group, each ending with lunch at the table.

### Indigo Woodworks, Indigo Valley
Woodworking courses in an off-grid workshop in the Indigo Valley, North East Victoria, run by Andy Hooke.
- [Four-Legged Milking Stool](https://getrealdays.com/indigo-woodworks/milking-stool/): $600 AUD per person, 2 full days, Saturday and Sunday. Build a four-legged stool from scratch over a weekend, for complete beginners.
- [Three Legged Perch Stool](https://getrealdays.com/indigo-woodworks/perch-stool/): $850 AUD per person, 3 full days. Shape and turn a three-legged perch stool over three days, for people with some woodworking experience.

### Peachy Keen Ceramics, Mount Eliza
Ceramics sessions and a lost wax ring workshop in a home studio in Mount Eliza.
- [Sunday afternoon in a ceramics studio](https://getrealdays.com/peachy-keen-ceramics/sunday-sessions/): $130 AUD per person, 2 hours. Make what you like in clay on a Sunday afternoon, with all materials and firings included.
- [Carve your own ring, cast in sterling silver](https://getrealdays.com/peachy-keen-ceramics/ring-workshop/): $280 AUD per person, 2 hours. Design and carve a ring in jeweller's wax, then have it cast in sterling silver, in a two-hour workshop in Mount Eliza.

### StudioMade by Darren McGinn, Newtown, Geelong
Two-hour pottery wheel taster classes in Darren McGinn's working studio in Newtown, Geelong.
- [Pottery Wheel Taster Class](https://getrealdays.com/studiomade/): $120 AUD per person, 2 hours. Two hours on the pottery wheel in a small class, with 2 of your pieces glazed and fired.

### Suigeneris Atelier, Mulgrave
Leather-making classes at Sui Workshop, the class studio of Suigeneris Atelier in Mulgrave, Melbourne.
- [Couple Leather Pencil Case Class](https://getrealdays.com/suigeneris-atelier/couple-pencil-case/): $120 to $135 AUD per person, 3 hours. Make matching leather pencil cases for two and stamp your names on them.
- [Classic Card Holder Class](https://getrealdays.com/suigeneris-atelier/card-holder/): $120 AUD per person, 3 hours. Make a classic leather card holder and learn stitching, gluing and edge finishing.
- [French Bakery Leather Charm Making Class](https://getrealdays.com/suigeneris-atelier/bakery-charm/): $123 to $150 AUD per person, Baguette 2.5 to 3 hours, croissant 4 to 4.5 hours. Make a leather croissant or baguette charm in Italian leather, step by step.
